column1: # Sitnikov system — a light body oscillating along the z-axis like a pendulum
# plane of two much heavier bodies that circle each other in the xy-plane. By symmetry the
# axial body feels a pure -z restoring force (independent of the binary's phase)
# between two extremes above and below the plane while the binary turns beneath it.
# This is the classic Sitnikov problem (a special case of the restricted three-body problem).
# The CIRCULAR version here is regular/integrable — a clean periodic pendulum; give the binary
# an eccentric orbit instead and it becomes the famous chaotic Sitnikov problem.
